title: Waymark
subtitle: Write scroll-driven stories with maps, photos and data. Publish them to a link anyone can open.

cover.kicker: Stories with a sense of place

blocks.text: Some stories can't be told in paragraphs alone. They need a map that moves with the reader, pictures that open up, and a page that changes as the story does.

blocks.title: The map follows the story
blocks.text: Cards scroll past while the map flies, tilts and zooms to each place.

slides.html:
Start with the whole world

Every card sets where the map should be. Readers just scroll.

Then zoom in close

Pick a place, tilt the camera, drop a marker. The map flies there on its own.

Bring your own data

GeoJSON, spreadsheets, or public ArcGIS layers, styled by category or value, with popups and a legend.

blocks.title: A page that responds to the reader
blocks.text: Chapters like this one recolor everything after them. Words light up. Numbers count. Photos drift.
